patterns: APPSC asks capital pairs (G1 2024: Avanti-Ujjain, Kosala-Shravasti, Vatsa-Kaushambi, Anga-Champa) and Assaka's capital Bodhan (G2 2012).
APPSC one-liners: Magadha most powerful in 6th-4th c. BCE; Bimbisara's dynasty = Haryanka; Charvaka = Lokayata.
Other PSCs: Anguttara Nikaya lists 16; Assaka on the Godavari; Suktimati = Chedi; Matsya = Rajasthan; Ahichchhatra = North Panchala; Nanda canal in Kalinga.
UPSC uses region-river pairs (Asmaka-Godavari, Kosala-Sarayu right; Kamboja-Vipas, Avanti-Mahanadi wrong) and kingdoms in Buddha's life.
App has many match/statement items on capitals and regions, plus Persian/Alexander and heterodox sects; depth broadly matches.
